info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Procurement Management API
info.description: The Procurement Management API facilitates streamlined management of procurement processes for enterprises. This endpoint enables users to initiate procurement requests for goods and services efficiently. It is designed for purchasing departments and enterprise resource planning systems that require automation in procurement cycles. Typical consumers include procurement professionals and business managers looking to enhance their organizational purchasing capabilities. The API supports integration with other enterprise services to optimize the overall supply chain management.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new procurement services in the enterprise system. It facilitates the management of procurement processes efficiently and effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a procurement operation within the enterprise services. It should contain all necessary details related to the procurement task, formatted as JSON.
